title: Boundary Patterns Configuration
description: Configuration for check-boundary.ts Layer 2 pattern scan and Layer 1 forbidden import namespaces. Forks should replace the brand patterns with their own identifiers.

forbiddenBrandPatterns.description: String patterns forbidden in platform code (Layer 2). Each entry is compiled into a RegExp.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern string (will be passed to new RegExp()).

message.description: Human-readable violation message shown in CI output.

forbiddenImportNamespaces.description: Brand namespace identifiers used to build Layer 1 forbidden import patterns. E.g. 'aevum' generates /(^|\/)aevum\//, /(^|\/)aevum-/, /^@aevum\//.
